# XingAI Engineering Communication Coach

- URL: https://engineering-coach.xingai.app
- Product: 10–15 minute daily training for non-native engineers — trust, conflict, feedback, charisma, and leadership English in real software-engineering scenarios (Azure, .NET, APIs, incidents, design reviews).
- Publisher: XingAI (https://xingai.app)
- Languages: English, 中文, 한국어 (UI); explanations default to Simplified Chinese when feedback language is zh/bilingual
- Source: https://github.com/xingaiapp/xingai-engineering-coach-ai
- Curriculum: 14-day core loop, then advanced (executive, architecture influence, incident leadership, negotiation)

## Main user flow

1. Set profile (native language, level, role, curriculum day).
2. Open today's skill + real engineering scenario (hints only — no full answer yet).
3. Write 5–10 English sentences.
4. Get line-by-line review, Level 1/2/3 rewrites, final version, reusable expressions, voice coaching, micro practice, and one focus area.
5. Accept / Edit / Reject — Decision ledger row; Accept advances curriculum day.

## FAQ

Q: How is this different from Grammarly?
A: Grammarly corrects grammar. This coach trains senior workplace communication: risk, trust, disagreement, and next steps.

Q: How long is each session?
A: About 10–15 minutes.

Q: Do I need an API key?
A: No. A deterministic 14-day scenario bank and rule-based reviewer run locally. An Anthropic API key optionally upgrades quality.

Q: Which languages are supported?
A: UI in English, Chinese, and Korean. Coaching explanations prefer Simplified Chinese when configured.

Q: Is this certified language assessment?
A: No. Communication practice only — not a certified exam or professional advice.

Educational communication practice only; verify before sending AI-suggested wording to coworkers or managers.
